decisions.reason: As a core cheese product very close to the firm's existing capabilities and having survived the first post-launch review, it fits the firm's knowledge base well and is therefore more likely to be improved and retained than discontinued.

Although the spicy variant is somewhat more niche and raises assortment complexity, it still builds directly on established cheese know-how, so despite limited visible R&D the firm would more likely keep it than drop it.

This mild creamy soft cheese clearly extends the existing cheese range in a familiar direction and appears to complete the assortment, which under the firm's absorptive capacity makes continued commercialization more likely than withdrawal.
